prose: The New York Times details Anthropic's compute-deal spree: more than 3.5 gigawatts of expected capacity coming online in 2026, sourced well beyond Nvidia's chips to Amazon, Google and AMD among others. The reporting underpins the $895 billion in purchase commitments and lease agreements disclosed in the amended S-1 - Anthropic is locking up power and silicon across every available supplier at once.
highlights: NYT: Anthropic has 3.5GW+ of expected capacity lined up for 2026, diversified across Amazon, Google, AMD and others
The deal spree is the physical footprint behind the S-1's $895B commitments figure
basis: Cache status: error (NYT paywall); summary written from the feed headline and the public S-1 figures it corroborates.
